preMappedTemplates.description: Set up your Trust Center using pre-mapped templates that provide a structured starting point for organizing your organization's trust information.
checklistItems: Start with a predefined Trust Center structure.
Customize the template to suit your organization's requirements.
Organize the information you want to showcase.

businessValue.label: BUSINESS VALUE
businessValue.description: Reduce initial setup effort, simplify configuration and establish a more organized foundation for presenting trust information.

accessGovernance.description: Choose which documents are publicly available and which require approval. Manage customer access requests while maintaining control over sensitive information.
checklistItems: Set documents as public or restricted.
Review, approve or reject access requests.
Verify business email addresses as part of access workflows, where supported.
Allow eligible domains to bypass manual approval.
Manage multiple access requests through bulk operations, where supported.

businessValue.label: BUSINESS VALUE
businessValue.description: Simplify document sharing, reduce repetitive approval work and maintain control over access to sensitive information.
